title: Plumeform looks bento (v2)
description: A dark band of frosted glass cards about customising a product's look. A picker list of layouts (each with a small icon and a FREE or PLUS tag; the chosen one sits on a lighter pill) drives a wide card beside it: a preview slot, the layout's name, a line and a dotted list, which swap in with a quick fade and rise. Below: a tall stat card with a huge paper-to-mint numeral, a wide card of colour-theme chips, three small mint-eyebrow cards and an underlined link. Cards rise and un-blur into view in turn.
notes: dark by itself (dark class); the preview is a slot per layout, a placeholder when empty
theme swatches take token names ("primary", "chart-3"…) so they follow the page's theme
needs JavaScript for the picker (hydrate: visible); without it the first layout shows
name: plumeform-v2-looks
